premises.text: Large companies lack information on their suppliers' environmental sustainability

premises.text: Consumer shareholders and the media are increasingly focused on supply chain sustainability problems
premises.evidence_span: consumer shareholders and the media are increasingly paying attention to supply chain sustainability problems

premises.text: A consulting approach alone cannot meet the critical need for supply chain sustainability management

premises.text: An integrated platform can help companies manage supply chain sustainability and evaluate risk

premises.text: Suppliers can be incentivized to improve their sustainability practices through visibility and benchmarking
